title: [Shoulder dislocation in athletes. Current therapy concepts].

sections.label: BACKGROUND
sections.text: Shoulder dislocation is a common injury in athletes participating in contact and overhead sports. Optimal treatment is still a subject of controversial debate.

sections.label: STUDY AIM
sections.text: Presentation of current concepts for therapy of shoulder dislocation in athletes.

sections.label: METHODS
sections.text: A selective literature search in PubMed was carried out.

sections.label: RESULTS
sections.text: Surgical and non-surgical therapy options are described in the literature and can be successful in certain situations. A gold standard has yet to be defined.

sections.label: CONCLUSION
sections.text: For decision-making numerous patient and sports-related factors need to be considered. There is a current trend towards early surgical stabilization in young athletes.
